title: FlorPio/gatk-cnv-somatic pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

tumor_bam.errorMessage: Tumor BAM file, when provided, must have extension '.bam'

normal_bam.errorMessage: Normal BAM file, when provided, must have extension '.bam'

tumor_counts.errorMessage: Tumor read counts file, when provided, must have extension '.hdf5' or '.tsv' (output of GATK CollectReadCounts)

tumor_allelic.errorMessage: Tumor allelic counts file, when provided, must have extension '.tsv' (output of GATK CollectAllelicCounts)

normal_allelic.errorMessage: Normal allelic counts file, when provided, must have extension '.tsv' (output of GATK CollectAllelicCounts)
